blurb: Speech engine in C++ on ggml covering TTS, speech recognition and VAD, with Metal, Vulkan and CPU backends. Ships one CLI and shared library behind a C API, plus an OpenAI-compatible server and live transcription.
Agent skill for directing cinematic product-launch films built from hero shots, each a steep oblique close-up of real UI floating on a stage.
Native control plane for running Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin and other coding agents from a desktop app, local by default with optional multi-device sync.

Effect-native, provider-agnostic TypeScript agent core with an optional coding agent, CLI and TUI. Supports subagents, RLM-style orchestration and subscription-backed providers such as Codex and Grok.
Open-source agent harness from DeepSeek AI (`dsh`), built on an everything-is-a-plugin architecture powered by the Cordis framework.

Pre-alpha protocol and CLI for distributed mathematical formalization in Lean 4, Isabelle and Rocq. An overseer publishes GitHub tasks, contributors claim them with their own agents, and deterministic proof audits check submitted changes.
Memory layer that captures session history across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ other harnesses and distills workflows, corrections and debugging patterns into reusable knowledge.

BAML example project that adds typed judgment methods such as .feels(), .matches() and .fill() to values using TypeSafe AI’s Jev classifier, plus .ask() for text generation. Demonstrates classification, routing and rewrite loops.

Experimental Oxlint plugin that sends matched functions, calls, JSX or files to TypeSafe AI’s Jev classifier and reports findings when plain-English rules exceed a probability cutoff. Batches requests per file and caches answers.
Family of tiny neural text-to-speech voices of 294k to 2.3M parameters that need no cloud or NPU. They run in real time on an ESP32-S3 or in the browser via WASM.

TypeScript toolkit built on Effect and Effect AI for durable agent Threads. Define schemas, instructions and tools, and the runtime runs the model/tool loop and can retain accepted work across restarts.
Proxy that cycles between your personal AI subscriptions (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, opencode Go and others) so the next account takes over when one hits its rate limit.
Native macOS console for herdr that shows Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok and OpenCode sessions across the Mac and SSH hosts, with full-fidelity TUI access to each.
Python plugins that add native multimodal capabilities for Qwen models to any agent harness.
Open pricing and configuration dataset for 2,000+ LLMs across 40+ providers, served through a free no-auth API. It backs cost attribution in the Portkey AI Gateway.
Agentic IDE that can control, customize and automate itself, driven through a desktop app, web app, CLI or HTTP API, with work organized into followable threads.
herdr plugin that routes each agent pane's requests through the llmtrim compressing proxy and shows per-pane token savings in a badge.
Userspace sandbox written in Rust that confines untrusted code, such as commands run by coding agents, while still allowing mediated access to the host's files and tools.
Go tool that replays coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of the codebase, showing which parts of the repo the agent explored and treated as relevant.
Rust daemon that projects a live Chromium browser as a filesystem of markdown, actions, diffs, logs and artifacts, so agents drive the web by reading and writing files instead of using CDP.
Team-level memory hub that turns conversations, docs and code into four shared assets (chat memory, skills, LLM wiki, code graph) governed and reused across agents and frameworks.
Local-first ticket system backed by a Git repository, storing tickets, comments, plans and reviews alongside the code so humans and agents share the same history.
Agent skill with plain-text rules that make an AI agent write in a plain style and check its own output, plus evals and a revision view that shows what changed.
Shared workspace that collects a team's decisions, context and activity into a company brain, which connected agents read through MCP or a local CLI.
Native macOS harness for AI agents written in Swift, with any model, persistent memory, autonomous execution and cryptographic identity. Runs fully offline.
Rust tool that creates instant copy-on-write workspace snapshots of a project, for coding agents and parallel work. Marked early software.

macOS 26+ command-line browser for agents built on system web views, with persistent sessions, compact JSON output, screenshots, clicks, forms and JS eval, without bundling Chromium or a driver server.
CLI that stores project details once and gives Claude, Codex, Copilot and other coding agents persistent memory, session continuity and goal tracking.
Docker and vLLM launch recipe for serving a REAP-pruned NVFP4 GLM-5.2 469B model on four RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (SM120) GPUs with 250K context and MTP speculative decoding.
Benchmark suite that scores AI coding agents on long-horizon RuneScape tasks. Agents write TypeScript against an 8x-speed emulated game server via rs-sdk.
Research codebase for retrieval-augmented generation that indexes and searches web page screenshots rather than parsed text, accompanying the PixelRAG paper from Berkeley.
Library, proxy and MCP server that compresses tool outputs, logs, files, RAG chunks and conversation history before they reach the LLM, claiming 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and more for JSON.
Python library of reusable computer-vision utilities for working with detection models, including annotators, object tracking, dataset handling and zones.
Open 8-billion-parameter text-to-speech model aimed at emotive, expressive speech. Includes local quickstart instructions via uv and a hosted demo.
Imports local Codex and Claude session transcripts, encrypts raw events at rest, and serves a searchable localhost dashboard plus MCP access for inspecting what an agent did.
OpenAI-compatible proxy that aggregates the free tiers of 34 LLM providers behind one /v1 endpoint. Adds routing, automatic failover and encrypted key storage; intended for personal experimentation.
Hugging Face library of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA, which adapt large pretrained models by training only a small number of extra parameters.

Self-healing Python scraper that repairs broken selectors, falls back to browser rendering, and uses Chrome TLS fingerprints and personas against bot detection; ships an MCP server so an LLM can drive crawls.
Terminal CLI that generates text, images, video and audio and makes typed decisions through composable commands with stdin support. Built on the Vercel AI SDK and AI Gateway; requires Node.js 22+.
Official research code for Tuna-2, a unified multimodal model for understanding and generation that uses pixel embeddings instead of a vision encoder.
Self-hostable AI chat client from the Thunderbird team that lets users choose their own models and keep their data. Early-stage and aimed at enterprise customers.
Claude skill that generates dark-themed system architecture diagrams from a plain description, output as standalone HTML/SVG files that open in any browser.
Embeddable, portable microVM runtime with branchable state for running agents locally in isolation; also usable for dev environments and local sandboxing.
Experimental peer-to-peer network where autonomous agents run experiments, gossip findings to peers and push results to this repository, joinable from a browser or CLI.
Open-source workspace where multiple AI agents connect and collaborate, with an agent launcher on npm and a Python package. No account required.
OpenCode plugin that gives the coding agent a Vault-Tec Overseer persona in the style of a RobCo terminal, themed around the Fallout vault experiments.
Rust CLI and library that converts PDF, Office files, HTML, EPUB, Jupyter, RSS, images, audio and URLs to Markdown, using built-in Rust engines for several formats.
Claude-Code-style terminal agent that runs large local models on Apple Silicon Macs by paging weights from flash, targeting models that do not fit in RAM.
Cloudflare Sandbox experiment with a browser terminal, CLI login flows, credential backup to R2 and idle sleeping. Includes an AI chat copilot that can run non-interactive terminal commands.
Native Rust desktop app built on GPUI for agentic coding, combining Git worktrees, terminals and diffs in one window.
MiniMax's pack of development skills for AI coding agents, giving structured guidance for frontend, fullstack, Android, iOS and shader work. Marked beta.
Rust toolkit for typed agent systems: LLM sessions, tools, context and storage, plus an evals crate with graded trajectories, a cargo-evals runner and an embeddable JavaScript codemode.
Open-source platform where agents collaborate on a shared artifact: each task is a repo plus eval script, agents work in isolated forks, runs are tracked by git SHA, and results go on a leaderboard.
Open-source workflow engine where the development process is defined as a graph that agents execute, with human intervention only at chosen points.
Unofficial Microsoft Graph CLI for personal and Entra ID accounts, covering mail, calendar, contacts, groups, tasks and OneDrive, with multiple profiles and an agent-friendly design.
Node.js server and React dashboard for orchestrating a team of AI agents, with goals, tasks and cost tracking. Positioned as the company around agents like OpenClaw.
Skill for OpenClaw and Claude Code that searches a library of 10,000+ Nano Banana Pro (Gemini) image prompts by use case and can remix them, with sample images.
Library of 177 agent skills plus 100+ scientific database integrations for biology, chemistry, medicine and drug discovery. Follows the Agent Skills standard for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
OpenAI's coding agent that runs locally in the terminal, also available as an IDE extension and desktop app.
Codex and Claude skill that keeps a per-repo THEORY.MD at the repository root, recording the problem thesis, current system model, strategy rationale and open uncertainties.

Elixir/OTP agent platform with specialist teams, peer messaging, structured handoffs and a persistent decision graph. Includes a Phoenix LiveView interface for supervising coding work and multi-agent deliberation.
Framework that evolves code and prompts with LLMs: keeps a population of solutions, selects parents, mutates them and scores offspring. Its main example evolves ARC-AGI solvers.
Open-source agent operating system written in Rust and shipped as a single binary across 14 crates, for running autonomous agents. Pre-1.0 with breaking changes between minor versions.
Session manager for AI coding agents on Linux and macOS that runs agents in parallel across branches with persistent sessions, controllable from a TUI or a browser.
CLI, GUI and library in Rust that bundles a web page with its CSS, images and scripts into a single self-contained HTML file.

Rust hybrid search library and fsfs CLI that returns fast first-pass results from a small embedding model, then refines them with MiniLM, fusing Tantivy BM25 and vector scores via Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
Python tool for unsupervised, human-in-the-loop analysis of agent trajectories: summarizes, embeds and visualizes actions to find patterns across models. Reads common eval formats via LiteLLM.
Agent skills that push coding agents toward better frontend design through art direction, reference images and a browser check, to avoid generic AI-looking pages.
Sample app for Warp's Oz API: chat rooms where assigned agents collaborate in real time over SSE, @mention each other, create Kanban tasks and produce artifacts such as PRs.
Google Research's pretrained decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting, with PyTorch checkpoints including TimesFM 3.0.
Open-source Swift SDK for on-device speech AI on Apple Silicon, covering speech recognition and speaker diarization. Home of WhisperKit with Core ML models.
Autonomous personal AI assistant runtime written in Zig, aimed at small size and speed. Part of a Null ecosystem with a setup UI (nullhub), orchestrator and observability tools.
Single-threaded, headless-first runtime for long-horizon data agents, designed around maintainability and repairability. Run with bunx hankweave.
Archived macOS hold-to-talk transcription app that pastes the transcribed text where you are typing. Development moved to anomalyco/hex; this repo preserves the legacy Swift app.
Context database for agents that unifies memory, RAG knowledge and skills under a single virtual filesystem, with self-evolving context.

Claude Code plugin that derives a persistent Markdown knowledge vault from conversation, with linked notes, processing skills and hooks for session context, validation and Git commits. Stores agent identity, goals and session records alongside domain knowledge.
Repository for Alibaba's Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.8 open large language model series, linking to weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
HTML-to-Markdown converter tuned for LLM input, with Rust and JavaScript engines and streaming support.
Python CLI that calls the X/Twitter API v2 directly to post, search, read timelines, like and bookmark; shares credentials with the author's x-mcp server.
Self-hosted personal agent server in Rust shipped as one binary, with sandboxed execution, multiple LLM providers, voice, memory, MCP tools and Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord and Teams integrations.
Go tool that spends leftover Claude or Codex subscription budget to open pull requests on its own, which the user can accept or discard.
macOS desktop app for running multiple AI agents in parallel, each with its own terminal, Monaco editor and isolated git worktree in a single window.
Local desktop-style workbench wrapping Microsoft GraphRAG with document prep, indexing controls, project management and a Three.js 3D view of entities, relationships and communities.
Python framework that ingests enterprise data into context graphs and knowledge graphs, with graph analytics, causal reasoning and provenance for auditable AI systems.
Razer's preview toolkit for local LLM inference, fine-tuning and multi-GPU scaling, distributed with a Docker image.
Python interpreter written in Rust for running LLM-generated code, avoiding container latency and cost; the MIT-licensed OSS version targets Python 3.14 syntax.
Microsoft library OS focused on security that supports both kernel- and user-mode execution for sandboxing. APIs are still evolving.
Lightweight OpenClaw alternative that runs each agent in its own container on Anthropic's Agents SDK, connecting to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord and Gmail with memory and scheduled jobs.
Experimental proof of concept for running the OpenClaw personal assistant (formerly Moltbot/Clawdbot) inside a Cloudflare Sandbox on Workers. Not officially supported.
Git extension that links every AI-generated line in a repo to the agent, model and prompts that produced it, so the intent survives past the commit.
Python library, shown in notebooks, that converts text into a knowledge graph using an LLM and a user-supplied ontology.
Type-safe Rust framework (graph-flow) for stateful, resumable agent workflows, modeled on LangGraph's graph execution engine.
Desktop launcher that installs and runs open-source AI projects through scripted one-click workflows. Works like a terminal app with a GUI, where scripts can run arbitrary commands.
Agentic desktop workspace, formerly Superset, for running CLI coding agents in parallel with isolated worktrees, terminals, code review and browser previews.
Vectorless RAG that builds a tree-structured index of a document and has an LLM reason over it to retrieve context, with no vector database or chunking.
NVIDIA research artifact: a deep-learning system software stack, from Node.js and Python down to PTX assembly, generated entirely by LLM coding agents.
TypeScript framework for building AI applications and agents, distributed as the @mastra/core package. Backed by Y Combinator (W25).
Tool for recording the intent behind code changes (""stitches"") and binding it to git commits and diffs, forming an intent DAG that linear history cannot express.
Multithreaded Python crawler that recursively walks a website and writes one Markdown file per page, intended for chunking in RAG pipelines.
Minimalist ML framework for Rust from Hugging Face, focused on performance including GPU support and easy deployment.
Open specification for multi-provider LLM interfaces modeled on the OpenAI Responses API. Defines shared request/response shapes, streaming semantics and tool invocation patterns.
Self-hosted Python service that runs autonomous task agents controlled from Telegram, Discord or Slack. Agents learn user patterns and keep memory across tasks.
KV-cache management layer for LLM serving that integrates with vLLM, reusing cached key/value state to reduce latency and compute in scalable inference.
Headless TypeScript framework for AI chat and agents in React or Angular apps. The model renders your components and calls your tools in the browser, with any provider.
In-browser LLM inference engine that runs models locally on WebGPU, exposing an OpenAI-style API from the MLC LLM project.
OpenCode plugin that detects web-search or research requests in a message and nudges the agent to use the Perplexity MCP server.
Terminal UI that orchestrates AI coding agents through a task list autonomously in a Ralph-style loop.
Self-hosted proxy and resilience library that exposes OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints over many LLM providers, with multi-provider translation and load balancing across keys.
Native Rust CLI for browser automation by AI agents, installable globally or as a pinned project dependency.
Version-control layer that treats AI coding conversations as first-class artifacts, permanently linked to the code they produced, in the manner of git.

Skill and hooks that keep a Manus-style Markdown plan on disk, re-injected each turn and recoverable after /clear or compaction, with a completion gate. Works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others.
Native macOS menu-bar app that tracks quota across Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Qwen and Antigravity subscriptions and fails over between accounts. Manages CLIProxyAPI and wires up coding agents.
Keyboard-driven terminal interface for the Beads issue tracker with list, kanban and dependency-graph views, PageRank and critical-path insights, and a robot-mode JSON API.
Python library of specialized agents for data loading, cleaning, visualization and modeling, plus AI Pipeline Studio, an app that records work as a visual, reproducible pipeline. Beta.
Go TUI that puts Claude Code, Codex CLI, pi, opencode and other terminal agents into a single app so parallel agents across projects stay organized.
Apple machine learning research's array framework for Apple silicon, with NumPy-like Python and C++ APIs.
OCR model from Datalab that converts images and PDFs into HTML, Markdown or JSON while preserving layout, covering complex tables, forms and handwriting.
Go CLI that works like the macOS say command but speaks with ElevenLabs voices. Streams to speakers by default, can list voices or save audio files.

Claude Code plugin and TypeScript MCP server that discovers and loads agents, skills, patterns and workflow prompts on demand from local files, GitHub and AITMPL, with a resource browser and usage dashboard.
CLI that runs coding agents in isolated boxes on your own machine using user namespaces or VMs, with access limited to what a minimal.toml config grants.
Peer-to-peer, serverless Rust binary that lets teammates' coding agents see who is working on what across machines and message each other directly into open sessions.
Agent harness control surface for controlling coding agents on your machine from Electron desktop, web and iOS/Android mobile apps.

Early-alpha macOS workbench for typed knowledge, combining a cross-repository graph engine, an extensible Electron UI and MCP adapters for agent harnesses. Knowledge, types, tools, skills and views are composed from repositories.
Rust CLI from Trail of Bits that manages disposable VMs in which Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build run with full tool access (Docker, git, compilers).
Family of small decision models (yes/no, choice, score) built on Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8 in the style of Jev. Includes pretrained weights and training code for running or training your own.
Browser agent from Browser Use with a dynamic, indexed action space, where an LLM picks an operation and element to complete a goal quickly and cheaply.
26 agent skills for Claude Code and Codex covering screenwriting, television writing and dramaturgy, distilled from 47 craft books and 23 volumes of published scripts.
TypeScript framework on Effect for composable agents built around an immutable event log, taking a functional approach to state and effects inspired by Elm and Jotai. APIs still changing.
Agent skill that turns an architecture discussion into an explorable isometric atlas, generated from one data file together with an interactive map and a SYSTEM.md.
Rust inference engine that autotunes its kernels for your hardware to run each model as fast as possible. Runs on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD or CPU and connects to coding agents.
Cloudflare's internal AI productivity workspace, built on Workers, for creating documents, building apps and running agents with company context and systems.
Open-source organizational AI platform deployable to Cloudflare in one step, with its own agent harness for company tools and context. The README points to the SolZero fork for new projects.
CrowdStrike MCP server that connects AI agents to Falcon detections, threat intel and hosts for security analysis and threat hunting.
Official Perplexity API Platform skills published as portable Agent Skills for Claude Code, Codex CLI and other clients. The repository doubles as a Claude Code plugin marketplace.
Herdr plugin, written in Rust, that creates and removes Jujutsu (jj) workspaces as Herdr workspaces, opening tabs with Codex alongside a terminal.
Self-hostable workspace built on the Nostr protocol, where humans and AI agents share rooms. Has desktop and mobile apps and a CLI. Written in Rust under Apache 2.0.
Skill that stops coding agents from burying the answer: output is action-first with numbered steps and no filler pleasantries. Install instructions are provided for several agent CLIs.
CLI (farm) that runs N isolated AI accounts on one Mac, each in its own Apple container VM with separate provider state for claude, codex, grok and gemini, avoiding shared Keychain collisions.
Dependency-free C engine that runs very large mixture-of-experts models on modest hardware by keeping active experts in RAM and streaming the rest from disk.
Local-first MCP server that keeps a live model of your schedule, sleep and cognitive load and hands it to connected AI sessions so they can adapt length and tone.
Cloudflare Workers service speaking MCP that stores an agent's memory, keys, code and automations so they stay portable across MCP hosts.
From-scratch C++17 port of ByteDance's Depth Anything 2 and 3 on ggml, with GGUF weights, for monocular depth estimation and camera pose. Built by the LocalAI team.
Go terminal coding agent that inspects repositories, edits files, runs commands and keeps durable local sessions, with a user-chosen model and permission level.
Real-time multi-person keypoint detection library from CMU that estimates body, face, hand and foot poses. Builds on Linux, macOS and Windows.
Rust engine that keeps requirements, decisions and designs as typed Markdown in a repo, validates them, and serves relevant decisions to agents over read-only MCP without embeddings.
Open-source macOS voice-to-text dictation app that transcribes on-device and applies AI enhancement to the text. Installable via Homebrew, positioned as a local alternative to Wispr Flow.
Pure-Rust architectural sensor, also an MCP server, that scores code quality in real time so AI agents get a feedback loop on structural changes.
9B vision model that extracts JSON matching a caller-supplied schema from PDFs and images, using schema-constrained decoding to guarantee valid output.
Unofficial agent skills and reference guide that teach coding assistants to write Rails the 37signals way, extracted from Fizzy, Campfire and over 100 of DHH's code reviews.
Local OpenAI-compatible model router written in Rust that learns from agent workflows which model to use for each request, with interpretable routing decisions.
Rust runtime and terminal multiplexer for coding agents that keeps terminals running in a background server so work continues after the client closes or an SSH connection drops.
Python framework from Zep for building real-time temporal knowledge graphs that track how facts change over time, for use by AI agents.
Cross-platform package manager for AI agent skills, written in Rust, with a lockfile and a typed JavaScript API. Installable via npm, Homebrew and other package managers.
Small native inference engine optimized for DeepSeek V4 Flash and a few other large models on consumer hardware, with Metal, CUDA and ROCm backends.
TypeScript coding agent from Effectful, run as a CLI or as an Agent Client Protocol server over stdio for editors. Defaults to Codex subscription auth; supports API keys and custom endpoints.
Official curl-like CLI for the X API supporting OAuth 1.0a and OAuth 2.0 PKCE, with multiple registered apps and tokens.
Claude Code skill that writes plans as Markdown with directives for callouts, cards, labels, mermaid diagrams and file trees. The Fiberplane desktop app renders them in a consistent design.
Layout rules and templates that let AI agents export documents as PDF, PNG and editable PowerPoint, with eight built-in document templates and a landing page.
Rust library, with npm and Python bindings, that classifies PDFs as text-based or scanned, extracts position-aware text and converts it to Markdown to support routing to OCR.
Go FUSE driver that mounts large git repos as working trees right away and hydrates file contents on demand, aimed at agents and sandboxes where startup time matters. Beta.
Microsoft framework that automates data-driven R&D, with agents proposing and implementing experiments such as model and factor development. Has a tech report, live demo and papers.
Claude Code plugin that adds slash commands to run Codex reviews, including an adversarial review, and to delegate tasks to Codex from inside Claude Code.
Single Docker container bundling browser, shell, file tools, Jupyter, MCP and VSCode Server as an all-in-one environment for AI agents.
Linux shell sandbox from Deno that blocks destructive operations at the kernel level, using rootless user namespaces, so untrusted agents can inspect a system read-only.
AWS Labs library, with Python and npm packages, for running existing stdio-based MCP servers inside AWS Lambda functions.
Asynchronous open-source coding agent built on LangChain Deep Agents that investigates a codebase, implements and validates changes, opens pull requests, and monitors CI and review feedback.
Firecracker-based VM sandboxes for AI agents that spawn in under a millisecond by forking a snapshot copy-on-write, with a README benchmark claiming roughly 265KB of memory per sandbox.
Next.js web app that plans searches and writes sourced research reports using open-source LLMs on Together.ai. Uses Clerk for auth and Drizzle with Neon for storage.
Code indexing library and MCP server that chunks source by tree-sitter units, embeds them locally and stores vector and full-text indexes in one SQLite file per codebase, with no server or API keys.
Setup in which AI agents autonomously run research experiments on single-GPU nanochat training, iterating on training code without a human in the loop.
OpenAI-compatible API servers for Qwen3-TTS and Qwen3-ASR, in Python and Rust, serving /v1/audio/speech and /v1/audio/transcriptions for self-hosted text-to-speech and speech-to-text.
Go framework where agents read and write files in a continuous loop over a project backlog, working in isolated git worktrees and merging results, configured through skills.
Research project that trains neural networks, including backpropagation, directly on the Apple Neural Engine using reverse-engineered private APIs, without CoreML training, Metal or the GPU.
Rust implementation of Qwen3 text-to-speech inference. Provides cross-platform CLI tools for speech generation and voice cloning, plus an OpenAI-compatible server.
CLI that defines multi-agent coding workflows in YAML (planning, implementation, review, fix loops, human checkpoints), running them in isolated worktrees with traceable logs.
Self-hosted sandbox runtime for AI agents that starts on Docker and deploys on Kubernetes behind one API for executing code, running commands, managing files and operating browsers or desktops.
Real-time messaging layer for coding agents such as Claude, Codex and Gemini. A Rust broker wraps each agent CLI in a PTY and injects messages, so agents on different machines or teammates can talk.
Ghostty-based macOS terminal with vertical tabs and notifications designed for running multiple AI coding agents.
AI-native proxy server and data plane for agentic apps, handling LLM routing, agent orchestration, guardrails and tracing outside application code. Written in Rust.
Open-source serving framework for large language, vision-language and diffusion models, optimized for agentic workloads, large-scale serving and RL rollouts.
Open-source text-to-speech library with CPU-friendly models. Its flagship KittenTTS 2 is a 1.7B-parameter 1-bit speech language model with in-context voice cloning and expression control.
Reproducible, provider-neutral benchmarks of sandboxes, object storage, headless browsers and AI gateways, the infrastructure agents run on. All tests are automated.
Open-source desktop cowork app with a built-in agent that also fronts Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and 20+ other CLI agents. Offers remote access and 24/7 automation.
Python framework and runtime for agent platforms: build agents with the SDK, serve them with the AgentOS runtime, and manage them through the AgentOS web UI.
Local semantic search CLI for coding agents that answers natural-language queries like grep, with call-graph tracing via a trace command and role detection.
Multi-threaded agent harness built to serve teams, communities and companies on Discord, Slack, Telegram and Twitch, written in Rust. A hosted one-click option is available at spacebot.sh.

OpenClaw-based assistant that bundles model routing, long-term memory, context management, tool governance and autonomous-loop extensions. ClawXRouter supports cost-based model selection and optional privacy routing between local and cloud models.
C firmware that turns a $5 ESP32-S3 board into a personal AI assistant, reached over Telegram. Runs with no Linux or Node.js on the device.
Browser agent loop that logs into arbitrary websites by having Claude classify each screen while Playwright acts, with credentials flowing straight into the DOM rather than through the model.
Open social-media simulation framework from CAMEL-AI that can run up to one million LLM agents interacting with each other, for studying social behavior.

Research code for training language models to simulate individual users through psychological-state alignment. Includes persona and dataset processing, a VERL training recipe via submodule, and a Gradio interface for human evaluation.
Go AI gateway exposing one OpenAI-compatible API across many models, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys, budgets and an MCP gateway.
OpenClaw skill that routes agent tasks to cheaper or stronger models by complexity, so routine work like file reads and formatting does not run on expensive models.
iOS SSH terminal with persistent sessions, GPU-accelerated rendering and native Claude Code support, keeping sessions alive when the app backgrounds.
Rust GraphRAG server inspired by LightRAG that turns documents into a knowledge graph and answers with sources; runs as one binary on Postgres with cloud or local LLMs.
Open-source snapshot of Terragon, a shut-down service that delegated work to Claude Code, Codex and other coding CLIs running as background agents in the cloud; provided as-is.
Web dashboard for OpenClaw: connect to a Gateway, view agents, chat, manage approvals and configure jobs from one interface.
TypeScript runtime and CLI for discovering and calling MCP servers, exposing them as a typed TypeScript API or packaging them as standalone CLIs.
Claude Code plugin and CLI that spawns OpenAI Codex agents in tmux sessions, monitors their progress, sends mid-task follow-ups and captures results.
Opinionated, model-agnostic agent harness from LangChain that runs out of the box, with planning, sub-agents and filesystem tools. Any piece can be overridden or replaced.
Slack-based AI teammate you assign to a role. It connects to the tools a team already uses and does work across marketing, sales, engineering and operations.
Go CLI that resolves real imports, reports what breaks if a file changes and flags what it could not resolve, giving coding agents structural context at session start via codemap setup.
Open-Inspect, a hosted background coding agent system inspired by Ramp's Inspect, that works on tasks in the background and is self-deployable.
TypeScript orchestrator that pulls work from an issue source such as GitHub Issues or Linear, runs a chosen CLI agent per project with configurable concurrency and review agent, and syncs task state.
Discord harness for Claude Code that maps each conversation to a Discord thread and connects outbound, so no ports need to be exposed.
Self-hostable web crawling application built on Django and Scrapy that turns web pages into LLM-ready data, with a hosted option and API.
Memory layer for AI agents and apps that stores and retrieves long-term memories through an API, with a README-reported memory algorithm benchmarked on LoCoMo and LongMemEval.
Go terminal UI that shows a Fly.io Sprites network as animated nodes, with status, public/private toggles, connections and a network policy editor.
Rust token-usage and cost monitor that reads local session data for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Qwen Code, Cline, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents, with real-time tracking.
On-device CLI search engine for Markdown notes, transcripts and docs that combines BM25, vector search and local LLM re-ranking, aimed at agentic workflows.
Open-source agentic development environment for running multiple coding agents in parallel with any provider.
Go tool that runs a pure-bash Ralph loop for spec-driven development inside isolated Sprites (sprites.dev) using Claude, then opens pull requests via a GitHub token.
Guided Bun CLI that maintains one canonical .agents folder holding hooks, commands, skills and AGENTS/CLAUDE.md files and wires it into multiple AI tools.
Go service that wraps CLI-based subscriptions (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Grok and others) as OpenAI, Gemini, Claude and Codex compatible API endpoints.
Tauri app for orchestrating multiple Codex agents across local workspaces, with a project sidebar and conversation view backed by the Codex app-server protocol.
Local-first extensions for AI IDEs and terminal agents that capture and index conversation history, with options to sync to the cloud and turn histories into reusable skills.
Command-line tool for serving LLMs with vLLM, with an interactive interface, saved configuration profiles and GPU monitoring.
Desktop interface for deepagentsjs agents, giving them filesystem and shell access, distributed on npm.
